note: Keel's default behaviour. Override per project in .keel/config.json (or run /keel:settings). 'marks' is ascii ([x] [>] [ ]) or emoji (✅ 🔄 ⬜); ascii shows in every terminal font. 'models' is the set tasks may be distributed among; 'tiers' maps Keel's agents to a model and overrides tiers.json.
